howItWorks.text: After enough contracts, the last destination of each Syndicate becomes a Showdown where the Leader hides among decoy suspects (Normal: 4/6/6/9 suspects for showdowns 1-4; Hardcore: 9/9/12/12). Suspects are purple in Instinct and show a pictogram above them when performing a behavior (tell). A leader profile consists of 1 Agenda, 2 Tells and 4 Looks. Only one suspect is a permissible target; killing a non-leader is not the end, but if the true leader escapes (e.g. after alert) the campaign fails.

categories.name: Agenda
categories.note: Wiki: Business = blue burner phones, Handover = green, Secret = red

categories.name: Hair
categories.note: No Hair = bald or very short/shaved

categories.name: Personality (Tells)
categories.note: Allergic=sneezes; Dehydrated=drinks; Foodie=eats food set out on map; Nervous=looks around; Reader=reads; Smoker=cigarette breaks; Sweet Tooth=eats carried candy

tips.text: Tattoos, earrings and necklaces can be small: check hands, necks, back of forearms, and look from several angles.
Agenda can be checked via burner phone colour: blue=Business, green=Handover, red=Secret.
The old music cue near the leader was removed in the May 2023 patch.
Avoid alerting: if the true leader flees the campaign fails; Lookouts (white outline, 'Lookout Nearby') and Assassins escorting suspects are the main risks.
